headline: Apple Intelligence doubles iPhone storage needs on latest models
summary: iOS 18's new AI features require significantly more storage space on newer iPhones, impacting users with limited capacity.
details: iOS 18, launched this week, introduces Apple Intelligence, a suite of AI-powered features designed to enhance user experience.

However, these advanced capabilities come with a substantial storage cost. Reports indicate that Apple Intelligence now demands nearly double the storage space on the latest iPhone models compared to previous software versions.

This increased requirement could pose a challenge for users who already have limited storage on their devices, potentially forcing them to manage their data more carefully or upgrade their storage plans.
The exact storage requirements vary depending on the iPhone model and the specific AI features being utilized, but the overall increase is notable.
